name: rstaff
description: rstaff — a Claude Code virtual engineering team. On-demand AI roles (Eng Manager, Implementer, Reviewer, QA, Release, Doc, Researcher) on a small always-on foundation of memory + security hooks and owned conventions. Its edge: a completion gate that blocks a stop when the tree changed without a green verify, and a fresh-context writer≠reviewer; see SECURITY.md for what each gate does and does not enforce. Refuses persona-sprawl and context bloat.

plugins.name: rstaff
plugins.description: Always-on security and verification gates with independent review, release, and diagnostic commands.

plugins.name: rstaff-pm
plugins.description: Product/PM toolkit: interview ideas into falsifiable tickets and tickets into specs, each judged by a fresh-context critic.

plugins.name: rstaff-ds
plugins.description: Data-science toolkit: notebook conventions and a fresh-context analysis reviewer; the notebook re-run gate lives in core.

plugins.name: rstaff-engineer
plugins.description: Engineering workflow commands, parallel delivery skills, and implementation conventions.

plugins.name: rstaff-ai
plugins.description: Optional AI evaluation and controlled experimentation tools for agent-generated output.

plugins.name: rstaff-ai-datadog
plugins.description: Optional Datadog LLM Observability analysis; requires a Datadog account and the Datadog connector.

plugins.name: rstaff-usage
plugins.description: Token usage accounting and context cost guards.

plugins.name: rstaff-delegation
plugins.description: External model consultation, routed task execution, and document drafting.
